title: SAT Calculator Strategies
intro: Owning a powerful calculator is not the same as scoring well with it. This guide is about judgement: knowing when the tool helps and when it slows you down, how to estimate to catch errors, how to verify an answer, and how to guess intelligently when you must. These habits are worth as many points as any formula.

items.name: Speed
items.formula: use the tool for messy work, not one-step math
